channel.title: Wire — Go
channel.description: Go from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: SIMD and Go: How the New Packages Work Under the Hood
Spinning is a Bounded Bet: Why Go Hides Its Spinlocks
item.description: A handmade spinlock in Go looks like eight lines of code. The missing ninth line is a policy, and the policy needs context the lock word cannot see. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: Cutting a Go Git Server's RAM Usage by Two-Thirds
MyGo: Build Desktop Apps in Go with No Cgo Required
item.description: Build desktop apps in Go. Windows draw native UI that MyGo paints on the GPU, written in Go alone with package ui, or show a web frontend in the system webview that calls Go through a TypeScript client generated from your code. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: TinyGo 0.43: Go for Microcontrollers and WebAssembly
item.description: Go compiler for small places. Microcontrollers, WebAssembly (WASM/WASI), and command-line tools. Based on LLVM. - Release 0.43.0 · tinygo-org/tinygo (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: Dancing Backwards with Go: Why TDD Feels Weird
item.description: “Write tests… first ? That sounds backwards.” I know exactly what you mean, but stay with me. This is going somewhere… backwards, and in high heels! (1 source: golangweekly)
